Docket 1.3.99

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score and how many problems each area has. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes), $349, or 4 payments of $87.25, to see what they are, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *A free audit is still there after you quit.* If you ran a free audit,
  quit Docket and bought it later, activating the key used to find nothing to
  open, and the app asked you to run the audit again. Docket now keeps the
  full report of your recent free audits on your Mac, sealed until the copy
  is paid. When you activate, they appear under Reports in full, without
  crawling the site again.

99 checks across 13 areas.
